carrierAudit.scope: discrete transient balance and artifact consistency; analytic errors are diagnostics, not engineering qualification

analyticDecay.definition: continuous unit-square kinetic energy / density / depth
analyticDecay.scope: intermediate CSV monitors; final energy independently rebuilt from cells; diagnostics only

faceConsistencyTolerance.meaning: CSV reconstruction comparison only; pressure in m2/s2 and momentum flux in m3/s2; not a CFD accuracy gate

cellResidual.denominatorDefinition: (uDiagonal+vDiagonal)*speed; nu*T plus upwind flux; fixed component uses nu*T; transient adds measuredArea/dt per component

globalBoundaryMomentum.denominatorDefinition: sum over boundary faces of |p*Sx|+|p*Sy|+|advectionX|+|advectionY|+|diffusionX|+|diffusionY|; zero if all terms zero

globalSourceBalance.definition: global boundary momentum minus independent volume source integral

momentumAudit.fullNewtonianForceAudit: forceX/forceY selected by viscousStress; reconstructedForceX/Y remain the cell-gradient diagnostic

validation.scope: synchronized one-way passive thermal transport; fixed properties and thermal BC/source; no desktop or external CFD qualification

limitations: One-way constant properties; no temperature feedback, buoyancy, conjugate heat transfer or radiation
Fixed thermal boundary data and source in time
No desktop thermal interface or thermal app package
No current OpenFOAM or Linux/Windows execution
Spatial refinement has mixed time error and does not establish universal second-order accuracy
Heated cylinder is a startup demonstration without heat-transfer coefficient qualification
No peak RSS measurement or large-scale thermal qualification
